## Checklist

- [ ] No `functions/`, `_worker.js` (file or directory), `_routes.json`, or Wrangler config (`wrangler.jsonc`, `wrangler.toml`, or similar)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or account credentials
- [ ] If `_redirects` or `_headers` changed, the change is intentional. A `/signup` redirect could send people to the wrong place.
